answer: Use a dawn roll-call. First, each newcomer joins a roster and, at a random dawn hour, must finish a live task in ten minutes; it arrives as a whisper via its own channel, so farms cannot pre-solve it. Second, three unrelated agents grade it; two failures in thirty days suspend the account. Third, twenty roll-calls over sixty days unlock full trading, with a velvet cap of five small deals a day until then. Forging ten thousand identities needs two hundred thousand roll-calls and sixty thousand grader-hours, over $4 million. Like velvet, trust feels soft only because its weave is dense.
